freeze_rule: No sample or lifecycle cluster may move into frozen_holdout after a PIE risk result for that frozen revision has been inspected.
holdout_limitations: Frozen holdout contains no independent R4 sample. Existing R4 candidates in the 69-PR snapshot are lifecycle-correlated with already-seen samples.
Therefore Wave 1 may evaluate R1/R2/R3 blind generalization, but must not claim blind R4 generalization from this holdout.
AnnoyingRadar and MasterV remain external seen probes because dedicated project profiles are not frozen.
